rubric: The task and its date with a countdown; blocks in time order including the first week after; items as single actions with checkboxes.
Items ordered by notice period and waiting time; the long-lead items first.
Groups for documents, people and offices to inform, and money; country-specific items marked 'check' with where to check.
No invented fees, deadlines or office names; the user's situation (children, pets, car, disability) adds its own items.
The three most-forgotten items and the one thing to do today.

prompts.text: We're moving from Germany to the Netherlands on 1 September for my wife's job, two kids (3 and 7) and a car. Make me a complete checklist.
Ich starte am 1. März einen neuen Job in einer anderen Stadt. Was muss ich vorher alles erledigen? Ich bleibe erstmal in meiner Wohnung und pendle.
زوجتي حامل والولادة متوقعة في شهر مايو. ما قائمة الأشياء التي يجب أن نجهزها قبل الولادة وبعدها في الأسابيع الأولى؟
Packing list for 10 days in Norway in September, hiking and some city days, hand luggage plus one checked bag.
I'm selling my car privately next month. What do I need to do and have ready, step by step?
Ich habe nächsten Monat eine Knie-OP und bin danach 6 Wochen eingeschränkt. Checkliste für vorher und für die Zeit danach, ich wohne allein im 3. Stock ohne Aufzug.
